text_block_list.text:
While walking through the academy grounds,
I overheard students chatting.

text_block_list.name: Easygoing Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what is this~~?!
Whose lost item is this~~~?

text_block_list.name: Serious Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Looks like a memo.
The content is... 'Passionate Romance Drama Review'?

text_block_list.name: Serious Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
'Words of Courtship: ★★★☆☆
The protagonist's passion didn't quite come through.
More fervent words are needed. Examples below↓'

text_block_list.name: Serious Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
'I dedicate both my life and this blade entirely to you.
So please, let me feel your warmth, your breath...
forever in these arms'—

text_block_list.name: Easygoing Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~ That's intense! Who wrote this?
Just saying, it definitely wasn't me!
choice_data_list: (I-It really is intense... Just who wrote that...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...!
Th-That's mine...!

I heard a voice right nearby.
—I see, so it belonged to her.
choice_data_list: (Still, stepping up right now would be...)

text_block_list.name: Serious Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
What should we do with this...
Should we turn it in as a lost item for now...?

text_block_list.name: Easygoing Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah~ Even if we asked around... Ahaha,
there's no way anyone would step forward and claim it—

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
I know the owner.
The one who wrote that is Durandal.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: WHAAAAAT...!!!?

text_block_list.name: Serious Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
............Huh?
I-Is that true, Light O-chan...?

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I have seen it many times so there is no mistake. That is
Durandal's romance drama review.

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
Every day, Durandal diligently watches romance
dramas and writes those notes with all her might.

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
Rain, shine, or snow,
she watches and writes with an astonishing degree of devotion.

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text: Which is precisely why—I have something to say to you all.

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
It is wrong to laugh at something a person wrote with complete sincerity.
No matter what the contents may be, it is not right.

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
Even if the contents make onlookers blush,
Durandal wrote it with utmost earnestness and dedication.

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
Laughing at her hard work is wrong,
and reading it without permission just to laugh at it is improper.

What she's saying is entirely reasonable.
However—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ~~~~!! Why...! Did you have to say...! All of that~~~~...!!

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
Believe, who has been working in the corner this whole time!
You could hear us?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I also think... what Light O-san is saying...
is not mistaken.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No matter what it is...
continuing something steadily every day is difficult.

text_block_list.name: Serious Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Believe-chan...

text_block_list.name: Easygoing Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Well, I mean... reading it without asking
and gossiping about it... was kind of bad on our part too...

text_block_list.name: Easygoing Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry, Durandal. Here you go.
Um... We're really sorry for looking inside without asking.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No... I was the one who dropped it...
I caused you trouble. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...Believe-san, thank you as well.
I feel like things settled down smoothly thanks to you...

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
—By the way, I just heard a stomach growl.
Who was that? Durandal?

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
Come, let us return it to Durandal quickly.
Her face must be bright red by now.

text_block_list.name: Easygoing Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, you're right...
Wait, her face is bright red...?

text_block_list.name: Serious Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Um, Durandal-chan... h-here.

text_block_list.name: Easygoing Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Uh, well... we heard it was yours.
Sorry for looking inside without asking... o-okay?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
N-No...
I was the one who dropped it, after all...

The matter seemed settled on the surface—
but an awkward atmosphere lingered for a while.

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
—By the way, I just heard a stomach growl.
Who was that? Durandal?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
N-No, it wasn't!!
Honestly, you really are something else~~~~...!!

Karston Light O, with her straightforward nature.
While that blunt honesty rescues people at times,
it undeniably leaves them flustered just as often.
